This '''planet''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the original homeworld of the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]]. Thousands of years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], they (who were at the time known by another name) migrated from their homeworld, with its unstable star, to the more habitable planet of [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]].
